description: This file contains unit tests for the HPACK encoder implementation in the quiche HTTP/2 library, specifically testing the hpack_encoder component with various header encoding scenarios.

classes.name: HpackHeaderTablePeer
classes.description: A test peer class for accessing internal header table entries.

classes.name: HpackEncoderPeer
classes.description: A test peer class for interacting with HpackEncoder, exposing internal methods for testing.

classes.name: HpackEncoderTest
classes.description: A parameterized test fixture for testing the HPACK encoder with different strategies.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the dynamic header table with entries for testing.

methods.name: SaveHeaders
methods.description: Stores headers observed during encoding for verification.

methods.name: ExpectIndex
methods.description: Prepares expected output for an indexed header.

methods.name: ExpectIndexedLiteral
methods.description: Prepares expected output for a literal header with index.

methods.name: ExpectNonIndexedLiteral
methods.description: Prepares expected output for a non-indexed literal header.

methods.name: ExpectString
methods.description: Prepares expected output for a string, choosing Huffman or identity encoding.

methods.name: CompareWithExpectedEncoding
methods.description: Compares actual encoded output with expected output for headers.
